entries.title: John 16:1
segments: "I have told you all this so that you may not stumble.

entries.title: John 16:2
segments: "They will excommunicate you from their synagogues; indeed the time is coming when any one who kills you will suppose that he is doing God's service.

entries.title: John 16:3
segments: "And they will do these things because they have not known my Father, nor me.

entries.title: John 16:4
segments: "But I have told you these things, that when the time comes you may remember that I told you about them, myself. I did not, however, speak of these things at first, because I was with you.

entries.title: John 16:5
segments: "But now I go my way to Him who sent me, yet none of you asks me, `Where are you going?'

entries.title: John 16:6
segments: "but sorrow has filled your hearts because I have told you these things.

entries.title: John 16:7
segments: "Yet--I am telling you the truth--my going is for your good. For unless I go away the Comforter will not come to you; but if I depart I will send him unto you.

entries.title: John 16:8
segments: "And he, when he comes, will convict the world of sins and of righteousness and of judgment;

entries.title: John 16:9
segments: "of sin, because they do not believe in me;

entries.title: John 16:10
segments: "of righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you will no longer see me;

entries.title: John 16:11
segments: "because the Prince of this world has been judged.

entries.title: John 16:12
segments: "I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them just now.

entries.title: John 16:13
segments: "But when he is come, that Spirit of Truth, he will guide you into the whole truth. For he will not speak on his own authority, but all that he hears he will speak, and will make known to you that which is to come.

entries.title: John 16:14
segments: "He will glorify me; for he will take of what is mine and will make known to you.

entries.title: John 16:15
segments: "Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said that he will take of what is mine and make it known to you.

entries.title: John 16:16
segments: "In a little while you shall behold me no more; and again in a little while you shall see me, because I am going to the Father."

entries.title: John 16:17
segments: At this some of his disciples said among themselves: "What does he mean by telling us, `In a little while you shall behold me no more; and again in a little while you shall see me,' and `because I am going to the Father'?"

entries.title: John 16:18
segments: So they kept asking: "What does that `little while' mean of which he speaks? We do not know what he is talking about."

entries.title: John 16:19
segments: Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and said: "Are you questioning one another about my saying, `A little while and you shall behold me no more, and again a little while you shall see me'?

entries.title: John 16:20
segments: "I tell you solemnly that you will be weeping and wailing while the world is rejoicing; you will be grief-stricken, but your grief shall be turned into gladness.

entries.title: John 16:21
segments: "A woman in labor has grief because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the babe she no longer remembers her anguish, because of joy that a child has been born into the world.

entries.title: John 16:22
segments: "So you also have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your heart will rejoice, and your joy shall no man snatch away from you.

entries.title: John 16:23
segments: "And in that day you will ask me no questions. Most solemnly I tell you that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he will give you.

entries.title: John 16:24
segments: "Hitherto you have asked nothing in my name; ask, and you shall receive, that your joy may be full.

entries.title: John 16:25
segments: "I have told you these things in figures; but the time is coming when I shall no longer speak in figures, but will tell you about the Father in plain words.

entries.title: John 16:26
segments: "In that day you shall pray in my name; and I do not tell you that I will ask the Father on your behalf;

entries.title: John 16:27
segments: "for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and believed that I came forth from the God.

entries.title: John 16:28
segments: "I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I am leaving the world, and am going to the Father."

entries.title: John 16:29
segments: "Ah," said the disciples, "now you are speaking plain language, and not using figures.

entries.title: John 16:30
segments: Now we are sure that you know all things, and have no need for any one to question you; by this we believe that you came forth from God."

entries.title: John 16:31
segments: "Do you now believe?" said Jesus;

entries.title: John 16:32
segments: "behold the hour approaches and is already come when you will be scattered, each man to his home, and will leave me alone; and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

entries.title: John 16:33
segments: "I have said all this to you that in me you might have peace. In the world you will have tribulation, but be courageous; I have overcome the world."
